description_en: Modifies an IP entry in an access control policy group
description_zh: 修改访问控制策略组中的IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-translator-acl-list-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id ipv6transacl-bp1b4z3tleyhq1s500000 --acl-entry-id ipv6transaclentry-bp1jzyn7ra8pyxehd0000 --acl-entry-comment client_IP --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIPv6TranslatorAclListEntry

parameters.help_en: The region of the access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group that contains the IP entry
parameters.help_zh: IP条目所在的访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group entry that contains the IP entry
parameters.help_zh: IP条目所在的访问控制策略组条目的ID
parameters.name: acl_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the access control policy group entry.

The description must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组条目的备注信息。

长度为2~100个字符，以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: acl_entry_comment
